defect.title: delegated conversation identity is not scoped by parent turn
impact: two independent parent turns can collide in one local delegated conversation namespace
provider affinity/thread state or persisted adapter state keyed by conversation_key can bleed across parents
a future Qwen adapter deriving stable task/batch/session identity from conversation_key can produce false resume/signature conflicts across independent parents
defect.why_parent_scope_is_not_parent_affinity_: Including a canonical parent-turn identifier in the local child identity only namespaces the child. It does not copy any Notion account id, remote thread id, Qwen account id, or provider thread state.

properties: different parent turns with the same child id remain isolated
provider target remains part of identity
bounded ASCII key is suitable as an input to later Qwen-safe task/batch/session ids

owner_handoff.minimal_regression: create two DelegationRequest values with the same task_id and different parent_turn_id; assert delegated_conversation_key differs, remains deterministic, and contains no provider account/thread identifiers
owner_handoff.do_not_do: Do not solve this by making child inherit the parent account/thread affinity. The fix is local identity namespacing only.
